invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create(), so 'result' should never be null.
config is used directly to access its methods, so it must be non-null on all paths.
context is dereferenced to obtain storage configuration, so it cannot be null.
The method return type and returned value guarantee this is true.
result is a new or factory-created table object, not the config instance.
